skill.summary: YouTubers and content creators edit raw video footage into HD edited videos using this skill. Accepts MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB, renders on cloud GPUs...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Editor AI HD — automated cloud-based HD video editing for content creators.
- Supports uploads in MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM (max 500MB); exports polished 1080p videos within minutes.
- Handles session setup and free token generation automatically.
- User-friendly workflows: quick HD edits, batch processing, timeline previews, and iterative refinements.
- Responds to common editing requests like cuts, transitions, text overlays, and audio tracks.
- Clear feedback and error handling for file support, export access, and credits.
